_meta.coords: normalised FotMob shotmap: x = native_x/105 in [0,1], x=1.0 is the goal line attacked (FotMob pre-orients all shots attacking that goal); y = native_y/68 in [0,1], y=0.5 is pitch centre, native handedness kept. Render the attacking half, goal at the right edge.
_meta.defs: goal: eventType=Goal, not own goal, not shootout; pen=true for in-play penalties. sot: isOnTarget and not isBlocked and not own goal (corrected Opta-matching derivation); goals included; capped at most recent 40.
